items.special_treatment: Two-phase system using ethyl acetate as co-solvent (35% v/v) and water. Substrate: cyclohexene oxide (200 mM), NaOCN (400 mM), wet cell biocatalyst (50 g/L). pH self-regulated at 10.5 by hydrolysis of ethyl acetate. Reaction temperature: 25°C. Reaction time: 29 hours for pilot scale. Reactor volume: 50 L (pilot), 1 L (lab scale). Exothermic reaction controlled by temperature controller. Post-processing: extraction with ethyl acetate, phase separation, concentration, crystallization with heptane, filtration. Isolated yield: 87%. Enantiomeric excess (ee): 53%. No additional buffer required due to self-pH control. Organic phase concentrated to 0.5x, crystallized with 4x heptane. Product: trans-hexahydro-2(3H)-benzoxazolone (HBC).
